title: VTC Install Claim Finish — payload
description: Complete first-administrator enrolment under a DID the founder already controls: the document is signed by the DID the install token names, verified against its live document, and carries the founder's step-up approver's enrolment statement over the claim's challenge. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

claimId.description: From claim/start 0.3, echoed verbatim. Also the `boundTo` of the statement.

approverDid.description: The founder's step-up approver. MUST equal the statement's issuer.

statement.description: The approver's complete, signed auth/step-up/approver/attest/0.1 document with `purpose: enrol`, `boundTo` equal to `claimId`, over the start's `challenge`. Verified as received.

Response.title: VTC Install Claim Finish — response payload

adminDid.description: The founder's DID — the DID the install token named and the claim was signed by — which vtc/admin/bootstrap writes as the first administrator.

setupSessionToken.description: EdDSA JWT (aud=vtc-install-session, 5min TTL) consumed by vtc/admin/bootstrap. The approver binding takes effect when it is consumed.
